分析游戏文件，处理文字提取与构建问题。: Analyze game files and handle extraction and build issues.
按场景翻译文字，校对译文、人物称呼和用词。: Translate scenes and review accuracy, names, and wording.
配置模型连接、制作选项和游戏字体。: Set up model connections, production options, and game fonts.
支持 OpenAI 兼容接口，包括提供该接口的本地模型。: Connect to an OpenAI-compatible API, including compatible local model servers.
先点击“保存设置”，再测试连接。: Save your settings before testing the connection.
连接测试会发送一条简短的模型请求，费用按服务商规则计算。: The test sends a short model request. Your provider may charge for it.
所有项目共用此上限，包括技术处理、翻译、校对和图片文字识别。: Shared across all projects: technical work, translation, proofreading, and image-text recognition.
例如：zh-Hans（简体中文）、en（英语）。: For example: zh-Hans (Simplified Chinese) or en (English).
默认共用上方连接，也可分别设置。翻译与校对共用文字模型。: Use the shared connection or configure each separately. Translation and proofreading share the text model.
初翻完成后，使用文字模型校对译文、人物称呼和译名。: After translation, use the text model to review translations and name consistency.
个别任务失败时暂停: Pause when an individual task fails
个别任务重试后仍失败时暂停；关闭后保留当前文字或原图，继续其他任务。: Pause if an individual task still fails after retries. When off, keep its current text or original image and continue other tasks.
支持平整背景 PNG 的局部文字翻译和回写；其他图片保持原样。: Translate and replace text in flat-background PNG regions. Other images remain unchanged.
成品将使用所选字体，也可选择自己的 TTF/OTF 文件。: Choose the font for the localized build, or select your own TTF/OTF file.
选择 TTF 或 OTF 字体: Choose a TTF or OTF font
内置字体采用 SIL Open Font License，许可证随成品提供。: Bundled fonts use the SIL Open Font License, included with the build.
使用服务商提供的 API 基础地址。: Use the API base URL supplied by your provider.
填写服务商列出的完整模型名称: Enter the full model name listed by your provider
留空保留已保存密钥，输入新密钥可替换: Leave blank to keep the saved key, or enter a replacement
填写模型服务商提供的 API 密钥: Enter the API key from your model provider
留空默认：上下文 32,768 tokens，单次回复 4,096 tokens: Defaults: 32,768 context tokens and 4,096 tokens per reply. For custom values, use your provider's specifications.
每次请求中，输入、历史和回复的合计上限。: The limit for input, history, and reply combined in one request.
单次回复的上限，按模型支持的输出容量填写。: The limit for one reply. Use your model's supported output capacity.
在“设置”填写接口地址、模型名和 API 密钥，保存后点击“测试已保存连接”。: In Settings, enter the endpoint, model name, and API key. Save, then choose "Test saved connection".
拖入游戏文件夹或启动程序。工程默认建在游戏旁边，保存译文与进度，原版保持不变。: Drag in a game folder or executable. By default, the project stores translations and progress beside the game. The original stays unchanged.
在“制作总览”点击“开始翻译与校对”。进度自动保存，暂停后可继续。: In Overview, choose "Start translation & review". Progress is saved automatically, so you can pause and resume.
在“成品与导出”查看生成结果。试玩并检查对白、选项、字体和存读档后，再导出分享: Find the result in Builds & Export. Check dialogue, choices, fonts, and save/load in the game before exporting a sharing ZIP.
按下面四步，制作独立汉化版。: Make a standalone localized copy in four steps.
外部翻译可使用“文字工作台”的导出、导入文字工作包功能。: For external translation, export and import text packages in Text Workbench.
从侧栏“使用教程”重新打开本指南。: Reopen this guide from Getting Started in the sidebar.
